decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several high-end and mid-range Bluetooth speakers. The Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 and Bose SoundLink Color II were the strongest contenders based on ratings, but the Harman Kardon is a bit too bulky for true portability and some reviews for the Bose Color II mentioned concerns about battery longevity after a year. The UE Megablast is quite expensive ($245) and users reported frustrating software loops with the Alexa integration. While the INSMY retro speaker is aesthetically pleasing, I have doubts about it matching the audio depth of the more established brands. Given these compromises at these price points, I've decided not to make a purchase today.
